mapper.select: /* ShiftMembershipMapper.countShiftMembershipOn */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SHIFT_SCH_TEAM_USER TU JOIN TB_SHIFT_SCH_TEAM_MGMT TM ON TM.CMPNY_CD = TU.CMPNY_CD AND TM.SITE_CD = TU.SITE_CD AND TM.SHIFT_CD = TU.SHIFT_CD AND TM.SHIFT_TEAM_ID = TU.SHIFT_TEAM_ID WHERE TU.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND TU.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND (TM.STR_DATE IS NULL OR TM.STR_DATE <= #{workYmd}) AND (TM.END_DATE IS NULL OR TM.END_DATE >= #{workYmd}) AND (TU.LEAVE_TEAM_YMD IS NULL OR TU.LEAVE_TEAM_YMD > #{workYmd})

/* ShiftMembershipMapper.existsShiftLockInMonth */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SHIFT_SCH_TEAM_USER TU JOIN TB_SHIFT_SCH_TEAM_MGMT TM ON TM.CMPNY_CD = TU.CMPNY_CD AND TM.SITE_CD = TU.SITE_CD AND TM.SHIFT_CD = TU.SHIFT_CD AND TM.SHIFT_TEAM_ID = TU.SHIFT_TEAM_ID WHERE TU.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND TU.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND TU.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND (TM.STR_DATE IS NULL OR TM.STR_DATE <= CONCAT(#{workYm}, '31')) AND (TM.END_DATE IS NULL OR TM.END_DATE >= CONCAT(#{workYm}, '01')) AND (TU.LEAVE_TEAM_YMD IS NULL OR TU.LEAVE_TEAM_YMD > CONCAT(#{workYm}, '01'))
